notes: Two releases in one — 2.10.0 was never cut, so this covers everything since 2.9.9. The audience prioritization and jobs-to-be-done workshops now feed the Keep/Kill/Evolve call directly, so a page that serves nobody the client invested in surfaces as a finding rather than a hunch — with four new reports, and two tools (inherit-from-section, and AI suggestion against your own audience library) that make tagging affordable on a full crawl. An audit can now consolidate several source sites, each with its own scope, owner and redirect map. And URL variant triage reads each page's rel=canonical to strip alternate views out of the queue: on a 13,000-row crawl that halved the work before any judgement was made.
